Planning ref: `orchestrator/project-8834` at `ef9f747a1ac2c3db74c12989d378ee4298a808a0`. The integration branch does not mismatch.

## Files likely to change
- `tests/e2e_smoke_canary_b.txt`

## Functions or modules to implement
- No code changes. In `tests/e2e_smoke_canary_b.txt`, change line 2 from `decompose-run: 41445772297` to `decompose-run: 41941001401`. Line 1 (`status: ok`) and the final newline stay as they are.

## Data structures affected
- None. This is a plain-text canary fixture.

## API or interface changes
- None.

Scope-mode: Hold Scope
Reuse-audit: extends tests/e2e_smoke_canary_b.txt
Scope-mode justification: The issue asks for exactly one value change in one file and says no other file may change. I checked the current file with `cat -A`. It has two newline-terminated lines (`status: ok$`, `decompose-run: 41445772297$`), so only the run ID needs to change. No helper, test, README or changelog edit is needed. Under §6 Core Priorities (Security > Correctness & safety > Backward compatibility > Operational clarity > Performance > Speed), the complete option and the minimal option are the same here.

## Decisions
### D1 — Rewrite the whole file with exact content
- Chosen: write the whole file as exactly `status: ok\ndecompose-run: 41941001401\n`.
- Alternatives considered: a regex substitution on line 2 only (for example `sed -i`).
- Why: §4 warns that regex edits can miss and still exit 0. Writing the full file guarantees exactly two lines and the trailing newline.

## Security considerations
- No trust boundaries, endpoints, secrets or external inputs are involved. The run ID is a public workflow run number taken from the issue body.
- Abuse case: an edit that also touches other files. The `files_touched` scope lock and the "No other file is modified" acceptance criterion block this.

## Potential risks or edge cases
- A missing trailing newline, CRLF line endings or an extra blank line would fail the acceptance criteria. Check with `cat -A`.
- Conflict check: none found. The file path and its current content match the issue description.

## Testing considerations
- `cat -A tests/e2e_smoke_canary_b.txt` should show exactly `status: ok$` and `decompose-run: 41941001401$`.
- `wc -l` should report 2.
- `git diff --stat` should show only this file.
